findings.title: claim() charges 0 payment while delivering skimmed yield (post-denormalize floor not re-guarded)
findings.description: The only zero-payment guard (L494) checks the 18-decimal aggregate totalNormalizedYield != 0; it does not re-check the post-discount, post-denormalize actualPayment computed at L498 (_denormalizeAmount(claimerPayment, rewardToken)), which floors. A strategy skims non-zero native yield to the claimer at L484, then actualPayment can floor to 0 and safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, this, 0) at L509 succeeds, delivering free yield. Floor mechanics at L617-640.
findings.impact: Dust only: <= ~1 USDC-wei per claim at 2% discount, <= ~$0.01 at 99.99% discount; one NFT burned per claim; strictly unprofitable to farm. Round-trip corollary confirmed floor-only, never over-credits. Severity is Low/QA despite Tier-3 machine proof; proof strength does not inflate severity.
attackPath: Strategy skims non-zero native yield to claimer at L484.
Aggregate totalNormalizedYield != 0 so the L494 guard passes.
Post-discount, post-denormalize actualPayment floors to 0 at L498 (e.g. underlyingReceived=1: 1e-6 USDC -> 1e12 -> discount 9.8e11 -> floor 0).
safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, this, 0) at L509 succeeds; claimer receives skimmed yield for 0 payment.
findings.recommendation: Add `if (actualPayment == 0) revert ZeroAmount();` immediately after L498.

methods: Foundry stateful invariant (Invariant A) shrank to underlyingReceived=1
Halmos refuted actualPayment > 0 in 0.64s with the identical counterexample (Property 1)

findings.title: Phlimbo allowance depletion bricks permissionless claim() until owner re-approves
findings.description: approvePhlimbo (L369-374) sets a fixed forceApprove allowance that is never topped up. Each claim()'s IPhlimbo.collectReward pull at L519 consumes the allowance; once cumulative phlimboAmount exceeds the approved amount, every subsequent permissionless claim() reverts until the owner re-approves. Atomic, owner-recoverable, no fund loss.
findings.impact: Availability: permissionless claim() can be bricked until the owner re-approves. No fund loss; owner-recoverable. Borderline Low/Medium availability.
attackPath: Owner sets a fixed Phlimbo allowance via approvePhlimbo (L369-374).
Successive claim() calls each consume allowance via IPhlimbo.collectReward (L519).
Cumulative pulls exceed the approved amount; subsequent claim() calls revert.
claim() remains bricked until owner re-approves.
findings.recommendation: Top up / re-approve Phlimbo allowance as part of claim flow, or use a max/auto-replenishing allowance, or expose a permissionless top-up.

findings.title: Owner configuration guardrails / centralization residual (discount cap, exchange-rate bound, Ownable2Step)
findings.description: Designed owner authority, not an exploit. setDiscountRate (L324-330) allows a 100% discount; the contract uses single-step Ownable (decl L57). The 'owner drains via 100% discount' / depeg High framing is suppressed as known issues #4/#5 (documented depeg adjustment, oracle-free tradeoff previously accepted, 'reckless admin' exclusion).
findings.impact: Centralization / configuration robustness only. Single-step Ownable can brick controls on a mistyped owner. No exploit primitive.
findings.recommendation: Optional QA guardrails: (a) adopt Ownable2Step (vs Ownable decl L57); (b) cap discountRate strictly < 10000 at L324-330 as input-validation.

evidence.suppressedFramings: Depeg / 100%-discount-drain High framing suppressed as known issues #4/#5; reject any 'owner drains' High re-raise.

findings.title: claim() NatSpec says pay-then-skim; code skims-then-pays (doc/impl mismatch)
findings.description: Cosmetic doc/impl mismatch: claim() docstring (L426-434) and interface (L314-323) describe pay-then-skim, but the code skims first (L484) then pays (L509). claim() is atomic + nonReentrant, so a failed payment rolls back the skim and NFT burn; this also refutes the 'yield-before-payment' exploit angle. No security impact.
findings.impact: Documentation only; no on-chain impact (atomic + nonReentrant).
findings.recommendation: Correct the NatSpec (L426-434) and interface comment (L314-323) to reflect skim-then-pay ordering.
